WITH c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    bill_customer_c_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_gender AS cd_gender,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_marital_status AS cd_marital_status,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_education_status AS cd_education_status,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_purchase_estimate AS cd_purchase_estimate,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_credit_rating AS cd_credit_rating,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_dep_count AS cd_dep_count,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_dep_employed_count AS cd_dep_employed_count,
    bill_cur_cdemo_cd_dep_college_count AS cd_dep_college_count
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'store'
    AND NOT bill_customer_c_customer_sk IS NULL
    AND sold_date_d_year = 2002
    AND sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3
    AND bill_cur_addr_ca_county IN (
      'Walker County',
      'Richland County',
      'Gaines County',
      'Douglas County',
      'Dona Ana County'
    )
    AND NOT bill_cur_cdemo_cd_demo_sk IS NULL
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM c
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS w
    WHERE
      w.channel = 'web'
      AND w.bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND w.sold_date_d_year = 2002
      AND w.sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3
  )
  OR EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS k
    WHERE
      k.channel = 'catalog'
      AND k.ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND k.sold_date_d_year = 2002
      AND k.sold_date_d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3
  )
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100

WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT
    item_i_item_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      item_i_item_sk,
      item_i_brand_id,
      item_i_class_id,
      item_i_category_id
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
    WHERE
      NOT item_i_item_sk IS NULL
  ) AS i
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      item_i_brand_id,
      item_i_class_id,
      item_i_category_id
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
    WHERE
      channel = 'store' AND sold_date_d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 + 2
    INTERSECT
    SELECT
      item_i_brand_id,
      item_i_class_id,
      item_i_category_id
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
    WHERE
      channel = 'catalog' AND sold_date_d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 + 2
    INTERSECT
    SELECT
      item_i_brand_id,
      item_i_class_id,
      item_i_category_id
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
    WHERE
      channel = 'web' AND sold_date_d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 + 2
  ) AS x
    ON i.item_i_brand_id = x.item_i_brand_id
    AND i.item_i_class_id = x.item_i_class_id
    AND i.item_i_category_id = x.item_i_category_id
), avg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    sold_date_d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 1998 + 2
)
SELECT
  channel,
  i_brand_id,
  i_class_id,
  i_category_id,
  SUM(sales),
  SUM(number_sales)
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    item_i_brand_id AS i_brand_id,
    item_i_class_id AS i_class_id,
    item_i_category_id AS i_category_id,
    SUM(quantity * list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    item_sk IN (
      SELECT
        item_i_item_sk
      FROM cross_items
    )
    AND sold_date_d_year = 1998 + 2
    AND sold_date_d_moy = 11
  GROUP BY
    channel,
    item_i_brand_id,
    item_i_class_id,
    item_i_category_id
  HAVING
    SUM(quantity * list_price) > (
      SELECT
        average_sales
      FROM avg_sales
    )
) AS y
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    channel,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id
  )
ORDER BY
  channel,
  i_brand_id,
  i_class_id,
  i_category_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT obt.sale_id) AS "order count",
  SUM(obt.ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
  SUM(obt.net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.ship_date_d_date BETWEEN '1999-2-01' AND (
      CAST('1999-2-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 DAY'
    )
    AND obt.ship_date_sk = obt.ship_date_d_date_sk
    AND obt.ship_addr_sk = obt.ship_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND obt.ship_addr_ca_state = 'IL'
    AND obt.call_center_sk = obt.call_center_cc_call_center_sk
    AND obt.call_center_cc_county IN (
      'Williamson County',
      'Williamson County',
      'Williamson County',
      'Williamson County',
      'Williamson County'
    )
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS other_obt
      WHERE
        (
          other_obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND other_obt.warehouse_sk <> obt.warehouse_sk
        )
        AND other_obt.channel = 'catalog'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS ret_obt
      WHERE
        ret_obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id
        AND ret_obt.has_return = 'Y'
        AND ret_obt.channel = 'catalog'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'catalog'
ORDER BY
  COUNT(DISTINCT obt.sale_id)
LIMIT 100

    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2, 1999 + 3)
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    SUBSTRING(obt.item_i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30),
    obt.item_i_item_sk,
    obt.sold_date_d_date
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 4
), max_store_sales AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax
  FROM (
    SELECT
      obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk,
      SUM(obt.quantity * obt.sales_price) AS csales
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2, 1999 + 3)
      )
      AND channel = 'store'
    GROUP BY
      obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk
  )
), best_ss_customer AS (
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk,
    SUM(obt.quantity * obt.sales_price) AS ssales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk
  HAVING
    SUM(obt.quantity * obt.sales_price) > (
      CAST(95 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 100.0
    ) * (
      SELECT
        *
      FROM max_store_sales
    )
)

WITH ssales AS (
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.bill_cur_addr_ca_state,
    obt.store_s_state,
    obt.item_i_color,
    obt.item_i_current_price,
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    obt.item_i_units,
    obt.item_i_size,
    SUM(sales_price) AS netpaid
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.has_return = 'Y'
      AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.bill_customer_c_birth_country <> UPPER(obt.bill_cur_addr_ca_country)
      AND obt.store_s_zip = obt.bill_cur_addr_ca_zip
      AND obt.store_s_market_id = 7
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
    obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.bill_cur_addr_ca_state,
    obt.store_s_state,
    obt.item_i_color,
    obt.item_i_current_price,
    obt.item_i_manager_id,
    obt.item_i_units,
    obt.item_i_size
)
SELECT
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name,
  SUM(netpaid) AS paid
FROM ssales
WHERE
  item_i_color = 'orchid'
GROUP BY
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name
HAVING
  SUM(netpaid) > (
    SELECT
      0.05 * AVG(netpaid)
    FROM ssales
  )
ORDER BY
  bill_customer_c_last_name,
  bill_customer_c_first_name,
  store_s_store_name

SELECT

  s.item_i_item_desc AS i_item_desc,

  s.store_s_store_name AS s_store_name,

  SUM(s.return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantity,
  SUM(c.quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantity
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS s

  AND NOT s.item_i_item_sk IS NULL

  AND c.sold_date_d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2)

  s.item_i_item_id,
  s.item_i_item_desc,

ORDER BY
  s.item_i_item_id,

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT
    returning_customer_c_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    returning_addr_ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(return_amount) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'web'
    AND has_return = 'Y'
    AND return_date_d_year = 2002
    AND NOT returning_addr_ca_address_sk IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    returning_customer_c_customer_sk,
    returning_addr_ca_state
), cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    returning_customer_c_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
    returning_customer_c_customer_id AS c_customer_id,
    returning_customer_c_salutation AS c_salutation,
    returning_customer_c_first_name AS c_first_name,
    returning_customer_c_last_name AS c_last_name,
    returning_customer_c_preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
    returning_customer_c_birth_day AS c_birth_day,
    returning_customer_c_birth_month AS c_birth_month,
    returning_customer_c_birth_year AS c_birth_year,
    returning_customer_c_birth_country AS c_birth_country,
    returning_customer_c_login AS c_login,
    returning_customer_c_email_address AS c_email_address,
    returning_customer_c_last_review_date_sk AS c_last_review_date_sk,
    returning_cur_addr_ca_state AS cur_state
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'web'
    AND has_return = 'Y'
    AND NOT returning_customer_c_customer_sk IS NULL
)

  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN cust
  ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = cust.c_customer_sk
WHERE
  ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
    SELECT
      AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2
    FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2
    WHERE
      ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
  )
  AND cust.cur_state = 'IL'
ORDER BY
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(obt.net_profit) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS gross_margin,
  obt.item_i_category,
  obt.item_i_class,
  GROUPING(obt.item_i_category) + GROUPING(obt.item_i_class) AS lochierarchy,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY GROUPING(obt.item_i_category) + GROUPING(obt.item_i_class), CASE WHEN GROUPING(obt.item_i_class) = 0 THEN obt.item_i_category END
    ORDER BY CAST(SUM(obt.net_profit) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) ASC
  ) AS rank_within_parent
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000
    AND obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk
    AND obt.item_i_item_sk = obt.item_sk
    AND obt.store_s_store_sk = obt.store_sk
    AND obt.store_s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    obt.item_i_category,
    obt.item_i_class
  )
ORDER BY
  lochierarchy DESC,
  CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0 THEN obt.item_i_category END,
  rank_within_parent
LIMIT 100

    AND obt.item_i_item_sk = obt.item_sk
    AND obt.store_s_store_sk = obt.store_sk
    AND obt.store_s_state IN (
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN',
      'TN'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'store'

    obt.item_i_class
  )

  lochierarchy DESC NULLS FIRST,
  CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0 THEN obt.item_i_category END,

SELECT
  obt.warehouse_w_state,
  obt.item_i_item_id,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        CAST(obt.sold_date_d_date AS DATE) < CAST('1998-04-08' AS DATE)
      )
      THEN obt.sales_price - COALESCE(obt.refunded_cash, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS sales_before,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        CAST(obt.sold_date_d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('1998-04-08' AS DATE)
      )
      THEN obt.sales_price - COALESCE(obt.refunded_cash, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS sales_after
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.item_i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    AND obt.item_i_item_sk = obt.item_sk
    AND obt.warehouse_sk = obt.warehouse_w_warehouse_sk
    AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN (
      CAST('1998-04-08' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    ) AND (
      CAST('1998-04-08' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'catalog'
GROUP BY
  obt.warehouse_w_state,
  obt.item_i_item_id
ORDER BY
  obt.warehouse_w_state,
  obt.item_i_item_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  asceding.rnk,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(best_obt.item_i_product_name)
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS best_obt
    WHERE
      best_obt.item_sk = asceding.item_sk
  ) AS best_performing,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(worst_obt.item_i_product_name)
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS worst_obt
    WHERE
      worst_obt.item_sk = descending.item_sk
  ) AS worst_performing
FROM (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      item_sk,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank_col ASC) AS rnk
    FROM (
      SELECT
        obt.item_sk AS item_sk,
        AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        obt.store_sk = 2 AND channel = 'store'
      GROUP BY
        obt.item_sk
      HAVING
        AVG(obt.net_profit) > 0.9 * (
          SELECT
            AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col
          FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
          WHERE
            (
              obt.store_sk = 2 AND ship_hdemo_sk IS NULL
            ) AND channel = 'store'
          GROUP BY
            obt.store_sk
        )
    ) AS V1
  ) AS V11
  WHERE
    rnk < 11
) AS asceding
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      item_sk,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank_col DESC) AS rnk
    FROM (
      SELECT
        obt.item_sk AS item_sk,
        AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        obt.store_sk = 2 AND channel = 'store'
      GROUP BY
        obt.item_sk
      HAVING
        AVG(obt.net_profit) > 0.9 * (
          SELECT
            AVG(obt.net_profit) AS rank_col
          FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
          WHERE
            (
              obt.store_sk = 2 AND ship_hdemo_sk IS NULL
            ) AND channel = 'store'
          GROUP BY
            obt.store_sk
        )
    ) AS V2
  ) AS V21
  WHERE
    rnk < 11
) AS descending
WHERE
  (
    asceding.rnk = descending.rnk
  )
ORDER BY
  asceding.rnk
LIMIT 100

WITH v1 AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_category AS i_category,
    obt.item_i_brand AS i_brand,
    obt.store_s_store_name AS s_store_name,
    obt.store_s_company_name AS s_company_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS d_year,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy AS d_moy,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name, obt.sold_date_d_year
    ) AS avg_monthly_sales,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name
      ORDER BY obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.sold_date_d_moy
    ) AS rn
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND (
        obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000
        OR (
          obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000 - 1 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 12
        )
        OR (
          obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000 + 1 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1
        )
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_category,
    obt.item_i_brand,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.store_s_company_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy
), v2 AS (
  SELECT
    v1.i_category,
    v1.i_brand,
    v1.d_year,
    v1.d_moy,
    v1.avg_monthly_sales,
    v1.sum_sales,
    v1_lag.sum_sales AS psum,
    v1_lead.sum_sales AS nsum
  FROM v1, v1 AS v1_lag, v1 AS v1_lead
  WHERE
    v1.i_category = v1_lag.i_category
    AND v1.i_category = v1_lead.i_category
    AND v1.i_brand = v1_lag.i_brand
    AND v1.i_brand = v1_lead.i_brand
    AND v1.s_store_name = v1_lag.s_store_name
    AND v1.s_store_name = v1_lead.s_store_name
    AND v1.s_company_name = v1_lag.s_company_name
    AND v1.s_company_name = v1_lead.s_company_name
    AND v1.rn = v1_lag.rn + 1
    AND v1.rn = v1_lead.rn - 1
)
SELECT
  *
FROM v2
WHERE
  d_year = 2000
  AND avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND CASE
    WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0
    THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / avg_monthly_sales
    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1
ORDER BY
  sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales,
  nsum
LIMIT 100

      )

      ELSE 0

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_manufact_id,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY obt.item_i_manufact_id) AS avg_quarterly_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq IN (
        1212,
        1212 + 1,
        1212 + 2,
        1212 + 3,
        1212 + 4,
        1212 + 5,
        1212 + 6,
        1212 + 7,
        1212 + 8,
        1212 + 9,
        1212 + 10,
        1212 + 11
      )
      AND (
        (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN (
            'scholaramalgamalg #14',
            'scholaramalgamalg #7',
            'exportiunivamalg #9',
            'scholaramalgamalg #9'
          )
        )
        OR (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
        )
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manufact_id,
    obt.sold_date_d_qoy
) AS tmp1
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN avg_quarterly_sales > 0
    THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_quarterly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / avg_quarterly_sales
    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1
ORDER BY
  avg_quarterly_sales,
  sum_sales,
  item_i_manufact_id
LIMIT 100

WITH v1 AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_category AS i_category,
    obt.item_i_brand AS i_brand,
    obt.call_center_cc_name AS cc_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS d_year,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy AS d_moy,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.call_center_cc_name, obt.sold_date_d_year
    ) AS avg_monthly_sales,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.call_center_cc_name
      ORDER BY obt.sold_date_d_year, obt.sold_date_d_moy
    ) AS rn
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.call_center_cc_call_center_sk = obt.call_center_sk
      AND (
        obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000
        OR (
          obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000 - 1 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 12
        )
        OR (
          obt.sold_date_d_year = 2000 + 1 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 1
        )
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'catalog'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_category,
    obt.item_i_brand,
    obt.call_center_cc_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_year,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy
), v2 AS (
  SELECT
    v1.cc_name,
    v1.d_year,
    v1.d_moy,
    v1.avg_monthly_sales,
    v1.sum_sales,
    v1_lag.sum_sales AS psum,
    v1_lead.sum_sales AS nsum
  FROM v1, v1 AS v1_lag, v1 AS v1_lead
  WHERE
    v1.i_category = v1_lag.i_category
    AND v1.i_category = v1_lead.i_category
    AND v1.i_brand = v1_lag.i_brand
    AND v1.i_brand = v1_lead.i_brand
    AND v1.cc_name = v1_lag.cc_name
    AND v1.cc_name = v1_lead.cc_name
    AND v1.rn = v1_lag.rn + 1
    AND v1.rn = v1_lead.rn - 1
)
SELECT
  *
FROM v2
WHERE
  d_year = 2000
  AND avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND CASE
    WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0
    THEN CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / avg_monthly_sales
    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1
ORDER BY
  sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales,
  nsum
LIMIT 100

    obt.item_i_item_id AS item_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_date IN (
        SELECT
          obt.sold_date_d_date
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          obt.sold_date_d_week_seq = (
            SELECT
              MAX(obt.sold_date_d_week_seq)
            FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
            WHERE
              obt.sold_date_d_date = '1998-02-19' AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
          )
          AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
      )
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_item_id
), cs_items AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_item_id AS item_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_date IN (
        SELECT

        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          obt.sold_date_d_week_seq = (

            WHERE
              obt.sold_date_d_date = '1998-02-19' AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store', 'web')
          )

      )
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'catalog'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_item_id
), ws_items AS (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_item_id AS item_id,
    SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (

      ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev

  WHERE
    NOT store_s_store_sk IS NULL
)

  CAST(sat_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / sat_sales2

  JOIN cal AS d

  WHERE
    d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1185 AND 1185 + 11

SELECT
  SUBSTRING(obt.warehouse_w_warehouse_name FROM 1 FOR 20),
  obt.ship_mode_sm_type,
  obt.web_site_web_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (
    obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk <= 30
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk > 30
      )
      AND (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk <= 60
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS "31-60 days",
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk > 60
      )
      AND (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk <= 90
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS "61-90 days",
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk > 90
      )
      AND (
        obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk <= 120
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS "91-120 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN (
    obt.ship_date_sk - obt.sold_date_sk > 120
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.ship_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11

    AND obt.warehouse_sk = obt.warehouse_w_warehouse_sk

  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq IN (

        1212 + 1,
        1212 + 2,
        1212 + 3,
        1212 + 4,
        1212 + 5,
        1212 + 6,
        1212 + 7,
        1212 + 8,
        1212 + 9,
        1212 + 10,
        1212 + 11
      )
      AND (
        (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN (
            'scholaramalgamalg #14',
            'scholaramalgamalg #7',
            'exportiunivamalg #9',
            'scholaramalgamalg #9'
          )
        )
        OR (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
          AND obt.item_i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
        )

    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_manager_id,

    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1

  avg_monthly_sales,
  sum_sales

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT
    item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
    SUM(ext_list_price) AS sale,
    SUM(refunded_cash + reversed_charge + store_credit) AS refund
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'catalog' AND has_return = 'Y'
  GROUP BY
    item_sk
  HAVING
    SUM(ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(refunded_cash + reversed_charge + store_credit)
), cross_sales AS (
  SELECT
    o.item_i_product_name AS product_name,
    o.item_i_item_sk AS item_sk,
    o.store_s_store_name AS store_name,
    o.store_s_zip AS store_zip,
    o.bill_addr_ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
    o.bill_addr_ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
    o.bill_addr_ca_city AS b_city,
    o.bill_addr_ca_zip AS b_zip,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_city AS c_city,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_zip AS c_zip,
    o.sold_date_d_year AS syear,
    o.bill_first_sales_date_d_year AS fsyear,
    o.bill_first_shipto_date_d_year AS s2year,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(o.wholesale_cost) AS s1,
    SUM(o.list_price) AS s2,
    SUM(o.coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS o
  JOIN cs_ui
    ON o.item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  WHERE
    o.channel = 'store'
    AND o.has_return = 'Y'
    AND NOT o.store_s_store_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.sold_date_d_date_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_customer_c_customer_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_addr_ca_address_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.item_i_item_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_cur_cdemo_cd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_cur_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_cur_addr_ca_address_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_first_sales_date_d_date_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_first_shipto_date_d_date_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.promo_p_promo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_hdemo_ib_lower_bound IS NULL
    AND NOT o.bill_cur_hdemo_ib_lower_bound IS NULL
    AND o.bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status <> o.bill_cur_cdemo_cd_marital_status
    AND o.item_i_color IN ('maroon', 'burnished', 'dim', 'steel', 'navajo', 'chocolate')
    AND o.item_i_current_price BETWEEN 35 AND 35 + 10
    AND o.item_i_current_price BETWEEN 35 + 1 AND 35 + 15
  GROUP BY
    o.item_i_product_name,
    o.item_i_item_sk,
    o.store_s_store_name,
    o.store_s_zip,
    o.bill_addr_ca_street_number,

    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_street_number,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_street_name,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_city,
    o.bill_cur_addr_ca_zip,
    o.sold_date_d_year,
    o.bill_first_sales_date_d_year,
    o.bill_first_shipto_date_d_year
)

  cs1.c_street_number,

  cs2.s1 AS s12,
  cs2.s2 AS s22,
  cs2.s3 AS s32,
  cs2.syear,
  cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2

    o.bill_addr_ca_street_number AS b_street_number, o.bill_addr_ca_street_name AS b_street_name, o.bill_addr_ca_city AS b_city, o.bill_addr_ca_zip AS b_zip,

    o.sold_date_d_year AS syear, o.bill_first_sales_date_d_year AS fsyear, o.bill_first_shipto_date_d_year AS s2year,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(o.wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(o.list_price) AS s2, SUM(o.coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS o JOIN cs_ui ON o.item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  WHERE o.channel = 'store' AND o.has_return = 'Y'
    AND o.store_s_store_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.sold_date_d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_customer_c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND o.bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_addr_ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND o.item_i_item_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_cur_cdemo_cd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_cur_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND o.bill_cur_addr_ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_first_sales_date_d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND o.bill_first_shipto_date_d_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND o.promo_p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND o.bill_hdemo_ib_lower_bound IS NOT NULL AND o.bill_cur_hdemo_ib_lower_bound IS NOT NULL
    AND o.bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status <> o.bill_cur_cdemo_cd_marital_status
    AND o.item_i_color IN ('maroon', 'burnished', 'dim', 'steel', 'navajo', 'chocolate')
    AND o.item_i_current_price BETWEEN 35 AND 35 + 10 AND o.item_i_current_price BETWEEN 35 + 1 AND 35 + 15
  GROUP BY o.item_i_product_name, o.item_i_item_sk, o.store_s_store_name, o.store_s_zip,

  cs1.c_street_number, cs1.c_street_name, cs1.c_city, cs1.c_zip, cs1.syear, cs1.cnt, cs1.s1 AS s11, cs1.s2 AS s21, cs1.s3 AS s31,
  cs2.s1 AS s12, cs2.s2 AS s22, cs2.s3 AS s32, cs2.syear, cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2
WHERE cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk AND cs1.syear = 2000 AND cs2.syear = 2000 + 1 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt

WITH sc AS (
  SELECT
    store_sk,
    item_sk,
    store_s_store_name,
    item_i_item_desc,
    item_i_current_price,
    item_i_wholesale_cost,
    item_i_brand,
    store_s_store_sk,
    item_i_item_sk,
    SUM(sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'store' AND sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
  GROUP BY
    store_sk,
    item_sk,
    store_s_store_name,
    item_i_item_desc,
    item_i_current_price,
    item_i_wholesale_cost,
    item_i_brand,
    store_s_store_sk,
    item_i_item_sk
), sb AS (
  SELECT
    store_sk,
    AVG(revenue) AS ave
  FROM sc
  GROUP BY
    store_sk
)
SELECT
  sc.store_s_store_name AS s_store_name,
  sc.item_i_item_desc AS i_item_desc,
  sc.revenue,
  sc.item_i_current_price AS i_current_price,
  sc.item_i_wholesale_cost AS i_wholesale_cost,
  sc.item_i_brand AS i_brand
FROM sb
JOIN sc
  ON sb.store_sk = sc.store_sk
WHERE
  sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave
  AND NOT sc.store_s_store_sk IS NULL
  AND NOT sc.item_i_item_sk IS NULL
ORDER BY
  s_store_name,
  i_item_desc
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_i_category,
    item_i_class,
    item_i_brand,
    item_i_product_name,
    sold_date_d_year,
    sold_date_d_qoy,
    sold_date_d_moy,
    store_s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY item_i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
  FROM (
    SELECT
      obt.item_i_category,
      obt.item_i_class,
      obt.item_i_brand,
      obt.item_i_product_name,
      obt.sold_date_d_year,
      obt.sold_date_d_qoy,
      obt.sold_date_d_moy,
      obt.store_s_store_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(obt.sales_price * obt.quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
        AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'store'
    GROUP BY
      ROLLUP (
        obt.item_i_category,
        obt.item_i_class,
        obt.item_i_brand,
        obt.item_i_product_name,
        obt.sold_date_d_year,
        obt.sold_date_d_qoy,
        obt.sold_date_d_moy,
        obt.store_s_store_id
      )
  ) AS dw1
) AS dw2
WHERE
  rk <= 100
ORDER BY
  item_i_category,
  item_i_class,
  item_i_brand,
  item_i_product_name,
  sold_date_d_year,
  sold_date_d_qoy,
  sold_date_d_moy,
  store_s_store_id,
  sumsales,
  rk
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  c_last_name,
  c_first_name,
  ca_city,
  bought_city,
  ss_ticket_number,
  extended_price,
  extended_tax,
  list_price
FROM (
  SELECT
    sale_id AS ss_ticket_number,
    bill_customer_c_customer_sk AS cust_sk,
    bill_addr_ca_city AS bought_city,
    bill_customer_c_last_name AS c_last_name,
    bill_customer_c_first_name AS c_first_name,
    bill_cur_addr_ca_city AS ca_city,
    SUM(ext_sales_price) AS extended_price,
    SUM(ext_list_price) AS list_price,
    SUM(ext_tax) AS extended_tax
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'store'
    AND NOT sold_date_d_date_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT store_s_store_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT bill_addr_ca_address_sk IS NULL
    AND sold_date_d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
    AND (
      bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 5 OR bill_hdemo_hd_vehicle_count = 3
    )
    AND sold_date_d_year IN (1999, 1999 + 1, 1999 + 2)
    AND store_s_city IN ('Midway', 'Fairview')
  GROUP BY
    sale_id,
    bill_customer_sk,
    bill_addr_sk,
    bill_addr_ca_city,
    bill_customer_c_customer_sk,
    bill_customer_c_last_name,
    bill_customer_c_first_name,
    bill_cur_addr_ca_city
) AS dn
WHERE
  NOT cust_sk IS NULL AND ca_city <> bought_city
ORDER BY
  c_last_name,
  ss_ticket_number
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  SUM(obt.net_profit) AS total_sum,
  obt.store_s_state,
  obt.store_s_county,
  GROUPING(obt.store_s_state) + GROUPING(obt.store_s_county) AS lochierarchy,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY GROUPING(obt.store_s_state) + GROUPING(obt.store_s_county), CASE WHEN GROUPING(obt.store_s_county) = 0 THEN obt.store_s_state END
    ORDER BY SUM(obt.net_profit) DESC
  ) AS rank_within_parent
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    AND obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk
    AND obt.store_s_store_sk = obt.store_sk
    AND obt.store_s_state IN (
      SELECT
        s_state
      FROM (
        SELECT
          obt.store_s_state AS s_state,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY obt.store_s_state ORDER BY SUM(obt.net_profit) DESC) AS ranking
        FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
        WHERE
          (
            obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
            AND obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk
            AND obt.store_s_store_sk = obt.store_sk
          )
          AND channel = 'store'
        GROUP BY
          obt.store_s_state
      ) AS tmp1
      WHERE
        ranking <= 5
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    obt.store_s_state,
    obt.store_s_county
  )
ORDER BY
  lochierarchy DESC,
  CASE WHEN lochierarchy = 0 THEN obt.store_s_state END,
  rank_within_parent
LIMIT 100

    (
      obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk = obt.ship_customer_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk

    )

  GROUP BY

  UNION ALL
  SELECT

    obt.bill_customer_c_last_name AS customer_last_name,

WITH ss AS (
  SELECT
    store_s_store_sk AS s_store_sk,
    SUM(ext_sales_price) AS sales,

  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE

    )
  GROUP BY

  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE

    AND has_return = 'Y'
    AND NOT return_store_s_store_sk IS NULL
    AND return_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) AND (
      CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), cs AS (
  SELECT
    call_center_sk AS cs_call_center_sk,
    SUM(ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(net_profit) AS profit
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'catalog'
    AND sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) AND (
      CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), cr AS (
  SELECT
    return_call_center_cc_call_center_sk AS cr_call_center_sk,
    SUM(return_amount) AS returns,
    SUM(return_net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'catalog'
    AND has_return = 'Y'
    AND return_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) AND (
      CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), ws AS (
  SELECT
    web_page_wp_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk,
    SUM(ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(net_profit) AS profit
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'web'
    AND NOT web_page_wp_web_page_sk IS NULL
    AND sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) AND (
      CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY'
    )
  GROUP BY
    1
), wr AS (
  SELECT
    return_web_page_wp_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk,
    SUM(return_amount) AS returns,
    SUM(return_net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'web'
    AND has_return = 'Y'
    AND NOT return_web_page_wp_web_page_sk IS NULL
    AND return_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-08-04' AS DATE) AND (

    )
  GROUP BY

  SUM(returns) AS returns,
  SUM(profit) AS profit

    'store channel' AS channel,
    ss.s_store_sk AS id,
    sales,
    COALESCE(returns, 0) AS returns,
    (
      profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0)
    ) AS profit
  FROM ss
  LEFT JOIN sr
    ON ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'catalog channel' AS channel,
    cs_call_center_sk AS id,
    sales,
    returns,
    (
      profit - profit_loss
    ) AS profit
  FROM cs, cr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'web channel' AS channel,
    ws.wp_web_page_sk AS id,
    sales,
    COALESCE(returns, 0) AS returns,
    (
      profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0)
    ) AS profit
  FROM ws
  LEFT JOIN wr
    ON ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk
) AS x
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    channel,
    id
  )
ORDER BY
  channel,
  id
LIMIT 100

WITH ws AS (
  SELECT
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS ws_sold_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.bill_customer_sk AS ws_customer_sk,
    SUM(obt.quantity) AS ws_qty,
    SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS ws_wc,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS ws_sp
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.has_return = 'N' AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'web'
  GROUP BY
    obt.sold_date_d_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.bill_customer_sk
), cs AS (
  SELECT
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS cs_sold_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.bill_customer_sk AS cs_customer_sk,
    SUM(obt.quantity) AS cs_qty,
    SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS cs_wc,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS cs_sp
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.has_return = 'N' AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'catalog'
  GROUP BY
    obt.sold_date_d_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.bill_customer_sk
), ss AS (
  SELECT
    obt.sold_date_d_year AS ss_sold_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.ship_customer_sk,
    SUM(obt.quantity) AS ss_qty,
    SUM(obt.wholesale_cost) AS ss_wc,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS ss_sp
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.has_return = 'N' AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.sold_date_d_year,
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.ship_customer_sk
)
SELECT
  ss_sold_year,
  ss.item_sk,
  ship_customer_sk,
  ROUND(
    CAST(ss_qty AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (
      COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0)
    ),
    2
  ) AS ratio,
  ss_qty AS store_qty,
  ss_wc AS store_wholesale_cost,
  ss_sp AS store_sales_price,
  COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) AS other_chan_qty,
  COALESCE(ws_wc, 0) + COALESCE(cs_wc, 0) AS other_chan_wholesale_cost,
  COALESCE(ws_sp, 0) + COALESCE(cs_sp, 0) AS other_chan_sales_price
FROM ss
LEFT JOIN ws
  ON (
    ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year
    AND ws.item_sk = ss.item_sk
    AND ws_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk
  )
LEFT JOIN cs
  ON (
    cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year
    AND ss.item_sk = cs.item_sk
    AND cs_customer_sk = ship_customer_sk
  )
WHERE
  (
    COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) > 0
  ) AND ss_sold_year = 2000
ORDER BY
  ss_sold_year,
  ss.item_sk,
  ship_customer_sk,
  ss_qty DESC,
  ss_wc DESC,
  ss_sp DESC,
  other_chan_qty,
  other_chan_wholesale_cost,
  other_chan_sales_price,

SELECT

  c_first_name,
  SUBSTRING(s_city FROM 1 FOR 30),
  ss_ticket_number,

  profit
FROM (
  SELECT
    sale_id AS ss_ticket_number,

    bill_customer_c_last_name AS c_last_name,
    bill_customer_c_first_name AS c_first_name,
    store_s_city AS s_city,
    SUM(coupon_amt) AS amt,

  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt
  WHERE
    channel = 'store'
    AND NOT sold_date_d_date_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT store_s_store_sk IS NULL
    AND NOT bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk IS NULL
    AND (
      bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 8 OR bill_hdemo_hd_vehicle_count > 0
    )
    AND sold_date_d_dow = 1
    AND sold_date_d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1, 1998 + 2)
    AND store_s_number_employees BETWEEN 200 AND 295
  GROUP BY
    sale_id,
    bill_customer_sk,
    bill_addr_sk,
    store_s_city,
    bill_customer_c_customer_sk,
    bill_customer_c_last_name,
    bill_customer_c_first_name
) AS ms
WHERE
  NOT cust_sk IS NULL
ORDER BY
  c_last_name,
  c_first_name,
  SUBSTRING(s_city FROM 1 FOR 30),
  profit
LIMIT 100

    obt.item_i_class
  )
ORDER BY
  lochierarchy DESC,

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    obt.item_i_category,
    obt.item_i_class,
    obt.item_i_brand,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.store_s_company_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy,
    SUM(obt.sales_price) AS sum_sales,
    AVG(SUM(obt.sales_price)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY obt.item_i_category, obt.item_i_brand, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_company_name
    ) AS avg_monthly_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_year IN (2000)
      AND (
        (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Home', 'Books', 'Electronics')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('wallpaper', 'parenting', 'musical')
        )
        OR (
          obt.item_i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Jewelry', 'Men')
          AND obt.item_i_class IN ('womens', 'birdal', 'pants')
        )
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.item_i_category,
    obt.item_i_class,
    obt.item_i_brand,
    obt.store_s_store_name,
    obt.store_s_company_name,
    obt.sold_date_d_moy
) AS tmp1
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN (
      avg_monthly_sales <> 0
    )
    THEN (
      CAST(ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / avg_monthly_sales
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END > 0.1
ORDER BY
  sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales,
  store_s_store_name
LIMIT 100

  SUM(o.ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS o
WHERE
  o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.item_i_manufact_id = 269
  AND o.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-18' AND (
    CAST('1998-03-18' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 DAY'
  )
  AND o.ext_discount_amt > (
    SELECT
      1.3 * AVG(i.ext_discount_amt)
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS i
    WHERE
      i.channel = 'web'
      AND i.item_sk = o.item_i_item_sk
      AND i.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN '1998-03-18' AND (
        CAST('1998-03-18' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 DAY'
      )
  )
ORDER BY
  SUM(o.ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  ship_customer_sk,
  SUM(act_sales) AS sumsales
FROM (
  SELECT
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.sale_id,
    obt.ship_customer_sk,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT obt.return_quantity IS NULL
      THEN (
        obt.quantity - obt.return_quantity
      ) * obt.sales_price
      ELSE (
        obt.quantity * obt.sales_price
      )
    END AS act_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.reason_sk = obt.reason_r_reason_sk
      AND obt.reason_r_reason_desc = 'Did not like the warranty'
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
) AS t
GROUP BY
  ship_customer_sk
ORDER BY
  sumsales,
  ship_customer_sk
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT obt.sale_id) AS "order count",
  SUM(obt.ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
  SUM(obt.net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    obt.ship_date_d_date BETWEEN '1999-5-01' AND (
      CAST('1999-5-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 DAY'
    )
    AND obt.ship_date_sk = obt.ship_date_d_date_sk
    AND obt.ship_addr_sk = obt.ship_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND obt.ship_addr_ca_state = 'TX'
    AND obt.web_site_sk = obt.web_site_web_site_sk
    AND obt.web_site_web_company_name = 'pri'
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS other_obt
      WHERE
        (
          other_obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id AND other_obt.warehouse_sk <> obt.warehouse_sk
        )
        AND other_obt.channel = 'web'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        *
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS ret_obt
      WHERE
        ret_obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id
        AND ret_obt.has_return = 'Y'
        AND ret_obt.channel = 'web'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'web'
ORDER BY
  COUNT(DISTINCT obt.sale_id)
LIMIT 100

sql.pretty_sql:
WITH ssci AS (
  SELECT
    obt.ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
    obt.item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
  GROUP BY
    obt.ship_customer_sk,
    obt.item_sk
), csci AS (
  SELECT
    obt.bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
    obt.item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk
      AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    )
    AND channel = 'catalog'
  GROUP BY
    obt.bill_customer_sk,
    obt.item_sk
)
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT ssci.customer_sk IS NULL AND csci.customer_sk IS NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS store_only,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ssci.customer_sk IS NULL AND NOT csci.customer_sk IS NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS catalog_only,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN NOT ssci.customer_sk IS NULL AND NOT csci.customer_sk IS NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS store_and_catalog
FROM ssci
FULL OUTER JOIN csci
  ON (
    ssci.customer_sk = csci.customer_sk AND ssci.item_sk = csci.item_sk
  )
LIMIT 100

    END
  ) AS store_only,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ssci.customer_sk IS NULL AND csci.customer_sk IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS catalog_only,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ssci.customer_sk IS NOT NULL AND csci.customer_sk IS NOT NULL
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS store_and_catalog
FROM ssci
FULL OUTER JOIN csci
  ON (
    ssci.customer_sk = csci.customer_sk AND ssci.item_sk = csci.item_sk
  )
LIMIT 100

def q1_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(1)
    cutoff_date = params["cutoff_date"]

    return (
        lineitem.filter(col("l_shipdate") <= lit(cutoff_date))
        .group_by("l_returnflag", "l_linestatus")
        .agg(
            col("l_quantity").sum().alias("sum_qty"),
            col("l_extendedprice").sum().alias("sum_base_price"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount"))).sum().alias("sum_disc_price"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount")) * (lit(1) + col("l_tax"))).sum().alias("sum_charge"),
            col("l_quantity").mean().alias("avg_qty"),
            col("l_extendedprice").mean().alias("avg_price"),
            col("l_discount").mean().alias("avg_disc"),
            col("l_orderkey").count().alias("count_order"),
        )
        .sort("l_returnflag", "l_linestatus")
    )

    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")

    cutoff_date = params["cutoff_date"]

    filtered = filtered.copy()
    filtered["disc_price"] = filtered["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - filtered["l_discount"])

def q2_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    region = ctx.get_table("region")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(2)
    size = params["size"]
    type_suffix = params["type_suffix"]
    region_name = params["region_name"]

    min_cost_per_part = (
        partsupp.join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
        .filter(col("r_name") == lit(region_name))
        .group_by("ps_partkey")
        .agg(col("ps_supplycost").min().alias("min_cost"))
    )

    return (
        part.filter((col("p_size") == lit(size)) & col("p_type").str.ends_with(type_suffix))
        .join(partsupp, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")
        .join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
        .filter(col("r_name") == lit(region_name))
        .join(min_cost_per_part, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")
        .filter(col("ps_supplycost") == col("min_cost"))
        .select(
            "s_acctbal",
            "s_name",
            "n_name",
            "p_partkey",
            "p_mfgr",
            "s_address",
            "s_phone",
            "s_comment",
        )
        .sort(["s_acctbal", "n_name", "s_name", "p_partkey"], descending=[True, False, False, False])
        .limit(100)
    )

def q2_pandas_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:

    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")

    region = ctx.get_table("region")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(2)
    size = params["size"]
    type_suffix = params["type_suffix"]
    region_name = params["region_name"]

    europe_region = region[region["r_name"] == region_name]

    europe_nations = europe_region.merge(nation, left_on="r_regionkey", right_on="n_regionkey")

    europe_suppliers = europe_nations.merge(supplier, left_on="n_nationkey", right_on="s_nationkey")

    supplier_parts = europe_suppliers.merge(partsupp, left_on="s_suppkey", right_on="ps_suppkey")

    min_cost_per_part = supplier_parts.groupby("ps_partkey", as_index=False).agg(min_cost=("ps_supplycost", "min"))

    filtered_parts = part[(part["p_size"] == size) & (part["p_type"].str.endswith(type_suffix))]

    part_supplier = filtered_parts.merge(partsupp, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")

    return (
        part_supplier[["s_acctbal", "s_name", "n_name", "p_partkey", "p_mfgr", "s_address", "s_phone", "s_comment"]]
        .sort_values(["s_acctbal", "n_name", "s_name", "p_partkey"], ascending=[False, True, True, True])

def q8_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    region = ctx.get_table("region")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(8)
    target_nation = params["target_nation"]
    target_region = params["target_region"]
    target_type = params["target_type"]
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    n2 = nation.select(col("n_nationkey").alias("n2_nationkey"), col("n_name").alias("nation"))

    return (
        part.filter(col("p_type") == lit(target_type))
        .join(lineitem, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")
        .join(supplier, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(n2, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n2_nationkey")
        .join(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")
        .filter((col("o_orderdate") >= lit(start_date)) & (col("o_orderdate") <= lit(end_date)))
        .join(customer, left_on="o_custkey", right_on="c_custkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="c_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
        .filter(col("r_name") == lit(target_region))
        .with_columns(
            col("o_orderdate").dt.year().alias("o_year"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount"))).alias("volume"),

            col("volume").filter(col("nation") == lit(target_nation)).sum().alias("nation_volume"),
            col("volume").sum().alias("total_volume"),
        )
        .with_columns((col("nation_volume") / col("total_volume")).alias("mkt_share"))

    filtered_parts = part[part["p_type"] == target_type]

        joined[joined["nation"] == target_nation].groupby("o_year", as_index=False).agg(nation_volume=("volume", "sum"))

def q10_pandas_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:

    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(10)
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    customer_keys = customer[["c_custkey", "c_nationkey"]]
    customer_detail = customer[["c_custkey", "c_name", "c_acctbal", "c_phone", "c_address", "c_comment"]]

    orders_window = orders[["o_orderkey", "o_custkey", "o_orderdate"]]
    orders_window = orders_window[
        (orders_window["o_orderdate"] >= start_date) & (orders_window["o_orderdate"] < end_date)
    ]

    returned_lines = lineitem[["l_orderkey", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_returnflag"]]
    returned_lines = returned_lines[returned_lines["l_returnflag"] == "R"]
    returned_lines = returned_lines.assign(
        revenue=returned_lines["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - returned_lines["l_discount"])
    )[["l_orderkey", "revenue"]]

    customer_orders = customer_keys.merge(orders_window, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey")
    order_lines = customer_orders.merge(returned_lines, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey")

    revenue_by_customer = order_lines.groupby(["c_custkey", "c_nationkey"], as_index=False).agg(
        revenue=("revenue", "sum")
    )

    with_nation = revenue_by_customer.merge(
        nation[["n_nationkey", "n_name"]], left_on="c_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey"
    )
    with_detail = with_nation.merge(customer_detail, on="c_custkey")

    return (
        with_detail[["c_custkey", "c_name", "revenue", "c_acctbal", "n_name", "c_address", "c_phone", "c_comment"]]
        .sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
        .head(20)
    )

def q11_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(11)
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]
    fraction = params["fraction"]

    nation_stock = (
        partsupp.join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .filter(col("n_name") == lit(nation_name))
        .with_columns((col("ps_supplycost") * col("ps_availqty")).alias("value"))
    )

    total_value = ctx.scalar(nation_stock.select(col("value").sum().alias("total")))
    threshold = total_value * fraction

    return (
        nation_stock.group_by("ps_partkey")
        .agg(col("value").sum().alias("value"))
        .filter(col("value") > lit(threshold))
        .sort("value", descending=True)
    )

def q14_pandas_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:

    import pandas as pd

    part = ctx.get_table("part")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(14)

    end_date = params["end_date"]

    filtered = lineitem[(lineitem["l_shipdate"] >= start_date) & (lineitem["l_shipdate"] < end_date)]

    joined = filtered.merge(part, left_on="l_partkey", right_on="p_partkey")

    joined = joined.copy()
    joined["revenue"] = joined["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - joined["l_discount"])
    joined["promo_revenue"] = joined["revenue"] * joined["p_type"].str.startswith("PROMO").astype(float)

    total_revenue = joined["revenue"].sum()
    promo_revenue = joined["promo_revenue"].sum()
    total_val = total_revenue.compute() if hasattr(total_revenue, "compute") else total_revenue
    promo_val = promo_revenue.compute() if hasattr(promo_revenue, "compute") else promo_revenue
    promo_percent = 100.0 * promo_val / total_val if total_val > 0 else 0

    return pd.DataFrame({"promo_revenue": [promo_percent]})

def q15_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(15)
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    revenue = (
        lineitem.filter((col("l_shipdate") >= lit(start_date)) & (col("l_shipdate") < lit(end_date)))
        .group_by(col("l_suppkey").alias("supplier_no"))
        .agg((col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount"))).sum().alias("total_revenue"))
    )

    max_revenue = ctx.scalar(revenue.select(col("total_revenue").max().alias("max_rev")))

    tolerance = abs(max_revenue) * 1e-9 if max_revenue else 1e-9
    return (
        supplier.join(revenue, left_on="s_suppkey", right_on="supplier_no")
        .filter((col("total_revenue") - lit(max_revenue)).abs() <= lit(tolerance))
        .select("s_suppkey", "s_name", "s_address", "s_phone", "total_revenue")
        .sort("s_suppkey")
    )

    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")

        )
        .join(partsupp, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")

        .group_by("p_brand", "p_type", "p_size")
        .agg(col("ps_suppkey").n_unique().alias("supplier_cnt"))
        .sort(["supplier_cnt", "p_brand", "p_type", "p_size"], descending=[True, False, False, False])
    )

def q17_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(17)
    brand = params["brand"]
    container = params["container"]

    avg_qty_per_part = lineitem.group_by("l_partkey").agg((col("l_quantity").mean() * lit(0.2)).alias("avg_qty"))

    filtered = (
        part.filter((col("p_brand") == lit(brand)) & (col("p_container") == lit(container)))
        .join(lineitem, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")
        .join(avg_qty_per_part, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")
        .filter(col("l_quantity") < col("avg_qty"))
    )
    totals = filtered.select(
        col("l_extendedprice").count().alias("__q17_price_count"),
        col("l_extendedprice").sum().alias("__q17_price_sum"),
    )
    return totals.select(
        ctx.when(col("__q17_price_count") > lit(0))
        .then(col("__q17_price_sum") / lit(7.0))
        .otherwise(lit(None))
        .alias("avg_yearly")
    )

        .join(lineitem, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")

        .filter(col("l_quantity") < col("avg_qty"))

def q17_pandas_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:

    import pandas as pd

    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    part = ctx.get_table("part")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(17)
    brand = params["brand"]
    container = params["container"]

    filtered_parts = part[(part["p_brand"] == brand) & (part["p_container"] == container)]

    avg_qty = lineitem.groupby("l_partkey", as_index=False).agg(avg_qty=("l_quantity", "mean"))
    avg_qty["avg_qty"] = avg_qty["avg_qty"] * 0.2

    joined = filtered_parts.merge(lineitem, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")

    joined = joined.merge(avg_qty, on="l_partkey")

    joined = joined[joined["l_quantity"] < joined["avg_qty"]]

    if len(joined) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame({"avg_yearly": [None]})
    avg_yearly = joined["l_extendedprice"].sum() / 7.0
    avg_yearly_val = avg_yearly.compute() if hasattr(avg_yearly, "compute") else avg_yearly

    return pd.DataFrame({"avg_yearly": [avg_yearly_val]})

def q18_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(18)
    quantity_threshold = params["quantity_threshold"]

    large_orders = (
        lineitem.group_by("l_orderkey")
        .agg(col("l_quantity").sum().alias("total_qty"))
        .filter(col("total_qty") > lit(quantity_threshold))
        .select("l_orderkey")
    )

    return (
        customer.join(orders, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey")
        .join(large_orders, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey", how="semi")
        .join(lineitem, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey")
        .group_by("c_name", "c_custkey", "o_orderkey", "o_orderdate", "o_totalprice")
        .agg(col("l_quantity").sum().alias("sum_qty"))
        .sort(["o_totalprice", "o_orderdate"], descending=[True, False])
        .limit(100)
    )

def q20_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(20)
    color_prefix = params["color_prefix"]
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    forest_parts = part.filter(col("p_name").str.starts_with(color_prefix)).select("p_partkey")

    shipped_qty = (
        lineitem.filter((col("l_shipdate") >= lit(start_date)) & (col("l_shipdate") < lit(end_date)))
        .group_by("l_partkey", "l_suppkey")
        .agg((col("l_quantity").sum() * lit(0.5)).alias("threshold"))
    )

    excess_partsupps = (
        partsupp.join(forest_parts, left_on="ps_partkey", right_on="p_partkey", how="semi")
        .join(shipped_qty, left_on=["ps_partkey", "ps_suppkey"], right_on=["l_partkey", "l_suppkey"])
        .filter(col("ps_availqty") > col("threshold"))
        .select("ps_suppkey")
        .unique()
    )

    return (
        supplier.join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .filter(col("n_name") == lit(nation_name))
        .join(excess_partsupps, left_on="s_suppkey", right_on="ps_suppkey", how="semi")
        .select("s_name", "s_address")
        .sort("s_name")
    )

def q21_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(21)
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]

    target_suppliers = (
        supplier.join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .filter(col("n_name") == lit(nation_name))
        .select(col("s_suppkey").alias("target_suppkey"), col("s_name"))
    )

    valid_orders = orders.filter(col("o_orderstatus") == lit("F")).select(col("o_orderkey").alias("valid_orderkey"))

    candidates = (
        lineitem.filter(col("l_receiptdate") > col("l_commitdate"))
        .join(target_suppliers, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="target_suppkey")
        .join(valid_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="valid_orderkey")
        .select("l_orderkey", "l_suppkey", "s_name")
    )

    candidate_orders = candidates.select(col("l_orderkey").alias("cand_orderkey")).unique()

    suppliers_per_order = (
        lineitem.join(candidate_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="cand_orderkey", how="semi")
        .group_by("l_orderkey")
        .agg(col("l_suppkey").n_unique().alias("num_suppliers"))
        .select(col("l_orderkey").alias("supp_orderkey"), col("num_suppliers"))
    )

    late_suppliers_per_order = (
        lineitem.filter(col("l_receiptdate") > col("l_commitdate"))
        .join(candidate_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="cand_orderkey", how="semi")
        .group_by("l_orderkey")
        .agg(col("l_suppkey").n_unique().alias("num_late_suppliers"))
        .select(col("l_orderkey").alias("late_orderkey"), col("num_late_suppliers"))
    )

    return (
        candidates.join(suppliers_per_order, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="supp_orderkey")
        .join(late_suppliers_per_order, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="late_orderkey")
        .filter(col("num_suppliers") > lit(1))
        .filter(col("num_late_suppliers") == lit(1))
        .group_by("s_name")
        .agg(col("l_orderkey").count().alias("numwait"))
        .sort(["numwait", "s_name"], descending=[True, False])
        .limit(100)
    )

def q21_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(21)
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]

    target_suppliers = (
        supplier.join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .filter(col("n_name") == lit(nation_name))
        .select(col("s_suppkey").alias("target_suppkey"), col("s_name"))
    )

    valid_orders = orders.filter(col("o_orderstatus") == lit("F")).select(col("o_orderkey").alias("valid_orderkey"))

    candidates = (
        lineitem.filter(col("l_receiptdate") > col("l_commitdate"))
        .join(target_suppliers, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="target_suppkey")
        .join(valid_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="valid_orderkey")
        .select("l_orderkey", "l_suppkey", "s_name")
    )

    candidate_orders = candidates.select(col("l_orderkey").alias("cand_orderkey")).unique()

    suppliers_per_order = (
        lineitem.join(candidate_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="cand_orderkey", how="semi")
        .group_by("l_orderkey")
        .agg(col("l_suppkey").n_unique().alias("num_suppliers"))
        .select(col("l_orderkey").alias("supp_orderkey"), col("num_suppliers"))
    )

    late_suppliers_per_order = (
        lineitem.filter(col("l_receiptdate") > col("l_commitdate"))
        .join(candidate_orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="cand_orderkey", how="semi")
        .group_by("l_orderkey")
        .agg(col("l_suppkey").n_unique().alias("num_late_suppliers"))
        .select(col("l_orderkey").alias("late_orderkey"), col("num_late_suppliers"))
    )

    return (
        candidates.join(suppliers_per_order, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="supp_orderkey")
        .join(late_suppliers_per_order, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="late_orderkey")
        .filter(col("num_suppliers") > lit(1))
        .filter(col("num_late_suppliers") == lit(1))
        .group_by("s_name")
        .agg(col("l_orderkey").count().alias("numwait"))
        .sort(["numwait", "s_name"], descending=[True, False])
        .limit(100)
    )

def q21_pandas_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:

    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(21)
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]

    supplier_nation = supplier.merge(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
    supplier_nation = supplier_nation[supplier_nation["n_name"] == nation_name]

    late_lineitems = lineitem[lineitem["l_receiptdate"] > lineitem["l_commitdate"]]

    supplier_late = supplier_nation.merge(late_lineitems, left_on="s_suppkey", right_on="l_suppkey")

    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late.merge(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")
    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late_orders[supplier_late_orders["o_orderstatus"] == "F"]

    order_suppliers = lineitem.groupby("l_orderkey", as_index=False).agg(num_suppliers=("l_suppkey", "nunique"))
    multi_supplier_orders = _to_list(order_suppliers[order_suppliers["num_suppliers"] > 1]["l_orderkey"])

    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late_orders[supplier_late_orders["l_orderkey"].isin(multi_supplier_orders)]

    all_late = lineitem[lineitem["l_receiptdate"] > lineitem["l_commitdate"]][["l_orderkey", "l_suppkey"]]

    result_keys = supplier_late_orders[["l_orderkey", "s_suppkey"]].drop_duplicates()

    merged = result_keys.merge(all_late, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey")
    orders_with_other_late = merged[merged["s_suppkey"] != merged["l_suppkey"]][["l_orderkey", "s_suppkey"]]
    orders_with_other_late = orders_with_other_late.drop_duplicates()

    orders_with_other_late = orders_with_other_late.copy()
    orders_with_other_late["_exclude"] = True
    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late_orders.merge(
        orders_with_other_late,
        on=["l_orderkey", "s_suppkey"],
        how="left",
    )
    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late_orders[supplier_late_orders["_exclude"].isna()]
    supplier_late_orders = supplier_late_orders.drop(columns=["_exclude"])

    return (
        supplier_late_orders.groupby("s_name", as_index=False)
        .agg(numwait=("l_orderkey", "count"))
        .sort_values(["numwait", "s_name"], ascending=[False, True])
        .head(100)
    )

def q22_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(22)
    country_codes = params["country_codes"]

    customer_with_code = customer.with_columns(col("c_phone").str.slice(0, 2).alias("cntrycode"))

    avg_balance = ctx.scalar(
        customer_with_code.filter((col("c_acctbal") > lit(0)) & col("cntrycode").is_in(country_codes)).select(
            col("c_acctbal").mean().alias("avg_bal")
        )
    )

    customers_with_orders = orders.select("o_custkey").unique()

    return (
        customer_with_code.filter(col("cntrycode").is_in(country_codes) & (col("c_acctbal") > lit(avg_balance)))
        .join(customers_with_orders, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey", how="anti")
        .group_by("cntrycode")
        .agg(col("c_custkey").count().alias("numcust"), col("c_acctbal").sum().alias("totacctbal"))
        .sort("cntrycode")
    )

    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(22)
    country_codes = params["country_codes"]

    customer = customer.copy()
    customer["cntrycode"] = customer["c_phone"].str[:2]

    positive_accounts = customer[(customer["c_acctbal"] > 0) & (customer["cntrycode"].isin(country_codes))]
    avg_balance = positive_accounts["c_acctbal"].mean()

        .agg(numcust=("c_custkey", "count"), totacctbal=("c_acctbal", "sum"))

    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    region = ctx.get_table("region")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(2)
    size = params["size"]
    type_suffix = params["type_suffix"]
    region_name = params["region_name"]

        partsupp.join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")

        .filter(col("r_name") == lit(region_name))
        .group_by("ps_partkey")

        part.filter((col("p_size") == lit(size)) & col("p_type").str.ends_with(type_suffix))
        .join(partsupp, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")
        .join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")

        .select(

    params = get_tpch_parameters(2)
    size = params["size"]
    type_suffix = params["type_suffix"]
    region_name = params["region_name"]

    europe_region = region[region["r_name"] == region_name]

    europe_nations = europe_region.merge(nation, left_on="r_regionkey", right_on="n_regionkey")

    europe_suppliers = europe_nations.merge(supplier, left_on="n_nationkey", right_on="s_nationkey")

    supplier_parts = europe_suppliers.merge(partsupp, left_on="s_suppkey", right_on="ps_suppkey")

    min_cost_per_part = supplier_parts.groupby("ps_partkey", as_index=False).agg(min_cost=("ps_supplycost", "min"))

    filtered_parts = part[(part["p_size"] == size) & (part["p_type"].str.endswith(type_suffix))]

    part_supplier = filtered_parts.merge(partsupp, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
    part_supplier = part_supplier[part_supplier["r_name"] == region_name]

    part_supplier = part_supplier.merge(min_cost_per_part, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="ps_partkey")
    part_supplier = part_supplier[part_supplier["ps_supplycost"] == part_supplier["min_cost"]]

    return (
        part_supplier[["s_acctbal", "s_name", "n_name", "p_partkey", "p_mfgr", "s_address", "s_phone", "s_comment"]]
        .sort_values(["s_acctbal", "n_name", "s_name", "p_partkey"], ascending=[False, True, True, True])
        .head(100)
    )

def q8_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    part = ctx.get_table("part")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    region = ctx.get_table("region")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(8)
    target_nation = params["target_nation"]
    target_region = params["target_region"]
    target_type = params["target_type"]
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    n2 = nation.select(col("n_nationkey").alias("n2_nationkey"), col("n_name").alias("nation"))

    return (
        part.filter(col("p_type") == lit(target_type))
        .join(lineitem, left_on="p_partkey", right_on="l_partkey")
        .join(supplier, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(n2, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n2_nationkey")
        .join(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")
        .filter((col("o_orderdate") >= lit(start_date)) & (col("o_orderdate") <= lit(end_date)))
        .join(customer, left_on="o_custkey", right_on="c_custkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="c_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
        .filter(col("r_name") == lit(target_region))
        .with_columns(
            col("o_orderdate").dt.year().alias("o_year"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount"))).alias("volume"),
        )
        .group_by("o_year")
        .agg(
            col("volume").filter(col("nation") == lit(target_nation)).sum().alias("nation_volume"),
            col("volume").sum().alias("total_volume"),
        )
        .with_columns((col("nation_volume") / col("total_volume")).alias("mkt_share"))
        .select("o_year", "mkt_share")
        .sort("o_year")
    )

    filtered_parts = part[part["p_type"] == target_type]

    joined = joined.merge(supplier, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")

    joined = joined.merge(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")
    joined = joined[(joined["o_orderdate"] >= start_date) & (joined["o_orderdate"] <= end_date)]

    joined = joined.merge(customer, left_on="o_custkey", right_on="c_custkey")

    joined = joined.merge(nation, left_on="c_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")

    joined = joined.merge(region, left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
    joined = joined[joined["r_name"] == target_region]

    joined = joined.copy()

    brazil_volume = (
        joined[joined["nation"] == target_nation].groupby("o_year", as_index=False).agg(nation_volume=("volume", "sum"))

    joined = joined.merge(supplier, left_on="l_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")

    joined = joined.merge(partsupp, left_on=["l_suppkey", "p_partkey"], right_on=["ps_suppkey", "ps_partkey"])

    joined = joined.merge(orders, left_on="l_orderkey", right_on="o_orderkey")

    joined = joined.merge(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")

    joined = joined.copy()
    joined["o_year"] = joined["o_orderdate"].dt.year
    joined["amount"] = (

        joined.groupby(["n_name", "o_year"], as_index=False)
        .agg(sum_profit=("amount", "sum"))
        .rename(columns={"n_name": "nation"})
        .sort_values(["nation", "o_year"], ascending=[True, False])

    customer = ctx.get_table("customer")
    orders = ctx.get_table("orders")
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")

    params = get_tpch_parameters(10)
    start_date = params["start_date"]
    end_date = params["end_date"]

    customer_keys = customer[["c_custkey", "c_nationkey"]]
    customer_detail = customer[["c_custkey", "c_name", "c_acctbal", "c_phone", "c_address", "c_comment"]]

    orders_window = orders[["o_orderkey", "o_custkey", "o_orderdate"]]
    orders_window = orders_window[
        (orders_window["o_orderdate"] >= start_date) & (orders_window["o_orderdate"] < end_date)
    ]

    returned_lines = lineitem[["l_orderkey", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_returnflag"]]
    returned_lines = returned_lines[returned_lines["l_returnflag"] == "R"]
    returned_lines = returned_lines.assign(
        revenue=returned_lines["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - returned_lines["l_discount"])
    )[["l_orderkey", "revenue"]]

    customer_orders = customer_keys.merge(orders_window, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey")
    order_lines = customer_orders.merge(returned_lines, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey")

    revenue_by_customer = order_lines.groupby(["c_custkey", "c_nationkey"], as_index=False).agg(
        revenue=("revenue", "sum")
    )

    with_nation = revenue_by_customer.merge(
        nation[["n_nationkey", "n_name"]], left_on="c_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey"
    )

    return (
        with_detail[["c_custkey", "c_name", "revenue", "c_acctbal", "n_name", "c_address", "c_phone", "c_comment"]]
        .sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)

    )

def q11_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    partsupp = ctx.get_table("partsupp")
    supplier = ctx.get_table("supplier")
    nation = ctx.get_table("nation")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    params = get_tpch_parameters(11)
    nation_name = params["nation_name"]
    fraction = params["fraction"]

    nation_stock = (
        partsupp.join(supplier, left_on="ps_suppkey", right_on="s_suppkey")
        .join(nation, left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .filter(col("n_name") == lit(nation_name))
        .with_columns((col("ps_supplycost") * col("ps_availqty")).alias("value"))
    )

    total_value = ctx.scalar(nation_stock.select(col("value").sum().alias("total")))
    threshold = total_value * fraction

    return (
        nation_stock.group_by("ps_partkey")
        .agg(col("value").sum().alias("value"))
        .filter(col("value") > lit(threshold))
        .sort("value", descending=True)
    )
